description: Header file defining the SharedStorageImplementation class, which implements multiple shared storage interfaces and manages notifications, storage operations, and event dispatching within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace.

classes.name: SharedStorageImplementation
classes.description: Main class implementing shared storage interfaces, managing notifications, storage operations, and event dispatching.

classes.name: SharedStorageImplementation::Store2Notification
classes.description: Inner class implementing IStore2::INotification to handle value change events from the store.

classes.name: SharedStorageImplementation::Job
classes.description: Nested class representing a dispatchable job for event handling.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the shared storage with the provided service.

methods.name: SetValue
methods.description: Sets a value in shared storage.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Retrieves a value from shared storage.

methods.name: DeleteKey
methods.description: Deletes a specific key from shared storage.

methods.name: DeleteNamespace
methods.description: Deletes an entire namespace from shared storage.

methods.name: SetNamespaceStorageLimit
methods.description: Sets storage limit for a namespace.

methods.name: GetNamespaceStorageLimit
methods.description: Gets storage limit for a namespace.

methods.name: getRemoteStoreObject
methods.description: Returns remote store object for a given scope.

methods.name: ValueChanged
methods.description: Handles value change events and notifies listeners.
